# WP-CLI commands

<!-- Generated by `composer docs:generate` from the operation registry. Do not edit this file: change the declaration and regenerate. -->

Each command runs one SEOCart operation, with the same application service, input validation, permission check and error codes as the operation's REST route and ability. Run it as a user who holds the capability it names, with `--user=<login>`. A failure prints `<code>: <message>` and ends with a non-zero exit status. Maintenance commands are not operations; `wp help seocart` lists them.

## `wp seocart fixture-stock adjust`

Adjusts the stock level of one fixture item by a signed change.

```sh
wp seocart fixture-stock adjust <item_id> --delta=<delta> [--reason=<reason>] [--note=<note>] [--format=<format>]
```

- Operation: `fixture_stock.adjust_stock`
- Capability: `seocart_manage_inventory`
- Error codes: `fixture_stock.insufficient` (409)

### Arguments

- `<item_id>`: Identifier of the stock item whose level is adjusted. A uuid.
- `--delta=<delta>`: Signed change to the stock level. A negative value decreases it. An integer from -1000000 to 1000000.
- `[--reason=<reason>]`: Why the stock level changed. One of `recount`, `damage`, `return`, `correction`. Default `correction`.
- `[--note=<note>]`: Free-text note stored with the adjustment. Text of at most 500 characters. Personal data.
- `[--format=<format>]`: Render the result in a particular format. One of `table`, `json`. Default `table`.
